round_note: The October sale's true best sellers, the cheap everyday buys and small gifts people kept adding to their carts, plus cozy basics as the weather turns.

picks.name: Fire TV Stick HD
picks.why: The cheapest way to make an older TV smart, and once again one of the top sellers of the October sale.

picks.name: Anker Nano Power Bank
picks.why: Pocket-size charger with a built-in connector, so there's no cable to forget. A favorite stocking stuffer.
picks.query: Anker Nano Power Bank built-in connector

picks.name: Amazon Smart Plug (2-Pack)
picks.why: Puts lamps and holiday lights on a schedule or on Alexa voice control. One of the most-reviewed smart home items on Amazon.

picks.name: Hoto 25-Piece Electric Screwdriver Kit
picks.why: Rechargeable screwdriver with 25 bits in a tidy case. A practical gift that kept selling after the sale.

picks.name: Nicetown Blackout Curtains
picks.why: Thermal curtains that block light and cold drafts. A steady seller as the days get shorter.

picks.name: Energizer AA and AAA Batteries (48 Count)
picks.why: A big mixed pack of batteries, handy for remotes and new toys before the holidays. One of the most-reviewed items on Amazon.
picks.query: Energizer AA AAA batteries 48 count combo pack

picks.name: Tide Odor + Oxi Laundry Pods
picks.why: Big-pack laundry pods that people stock up on, and one of the top household sellers this month.
picks.query: Tide Odor Oxi laundry detergent pods 63 count

picks.name: Dawn Platinum Powerwash Dish Spray
picks.why: Spray-and-wipe dish soap with a huge fan base. An easy repeat purchase.
picks.query: Dawn Platinum Powerwash Dish Spray bundle refills

picks.name: KitchenAid Silicone Oven Mitts (2-Pack)
picks.why: Ribbed silicone mitts with a soft lining, ready for holiday baking. A top kitchen seller this month.
picks.query: KitchenAid Ribbed Soft Silicone Oven Mitt 2 pack

picks.name: LANEIGE Lip Glowy Balm
picks.why: Tinted, glossy lip balm that moisturizes without feeling sticky. A beauty best seller and an easy small gift.

picks.name: Medicube Toner Pads
picks.why: K-beauty toner pads that were among the best-selling skincare of the October sale. A quick, no-mess way to prep skin.

picks.name: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizing Cream
picks.why: Lightweight Korean moisturizer for dry fall skin, from one of the fastest-rising K-beauty brands on Amazon.
picks.query: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream

picks.name: EverFoams Fuzzy Slippers
picks.why: Faux-fur slippers with memory foam and a non-slip sole. Cold-weather favorites that sell out by December.
picks.query: EverFoams women's fuzzy memory foam slippers

picks.name: Hanes Women's Full-Zip Hoodie
picks.why: Classic fleece zip-up in lots of colors at a basics price. A fall layering staple.

picks.name: Owala FreeSip 40 oz Water Bottle
picks.why: Insulated bottle you can sip through the straw or swig from the spout. One of the most-bought water bottles on Amazon.
picks.query: Owala FreeSip 40 oz stainless steel water bottle

picks.name: FYY Travel Cable Organizer Pouch
picks.why: Waterproof pouch with sections for chargers and earbuds. Handy before holiday trips.
